/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: The Loop Climber is an overhead monkey bar frame with a row of yellow rings hung along the top and a ladder at each end. Children climb up one side, swing hand over hand along the rings and climb down the other. Rings ask for more grip and timing than straight bars, so this piece suits children who have already mastered a basic set of monkey bars. The frame takes up 10'10" x 4'8" and needs a safe play area of 15'10" x 7'8", which fits a narrow strip beside a path or boundary wall. It comes in Play Yellow and Lavender. The galvanised pipe frame carries our 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Send us your site measurements and we will place it on a layout drawing for you.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.spec_paragraph: The uprights and the ring frame are galvanised pipe, so the climber copes with rain and humidity without rusting through. We install it self-standing or grouted, depending on your ground. Children drop from the rings, so lay rubber flooring or another impact-absorbing surface across the whole 15'10" x 7'8" zone and check the ring fixings during routine maintenance.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Monkey bars are a familiar sight on school grounds, and the Monkey Climber is our straight version. Yellow rungs run in a level line between two side ladders, set on a black frame. A child reaches up, grips a rung and moves across one bar at a time, building arm strength and grip with practice. Children tend to queue at one ladder and climb off at the other, so play flows in one direction and the line moves quickly. The footprint is 3'3" x 11'6" and the safe play area is 8'3" x 16'6". Colours are Play Yellow and New Black. Our 3-year warranty covers the galvanised pipe frame for manufacturing defects. Tell us how much open ground you have and we will check the fit.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.spec_paragraph: We fabricate the Monkey Climber from galvanised pipe at our Vasai factory and finish it in New Black with Play Yellow rungs. It can be grouted into the ground or installed self-standing. Children let go from height at both ends, so keep a soft surface under the full length of the bars and tighten any loose rung fittings during maintenance.
flags: Age Group and Key User Group are NA.
Capacity 15 seems high for a straight monkey bar. Confirm.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: The Mushroom Climber is an arched overhead ladder in Play Red and Play Yellow, with a small bird figure as a decorative touch. Children climb the curve from one end, move along the rungs over the top of the arch and come down the far side. Because the rungs rise and then fall, each crossing feels different from a flat set of bars. At only 1'6" wide and 13'6" long, it slots along the edge of a garden or between two larger pieces. Plan a safe play area of 18'6" x 6'6" around it. The galvanised frame and roto-moulded parts come with our 3-year warranty. Ask us to show where it would sit on your play area layout.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.spec_paragraph: The arch is galvanised steel finished in red and yellow, and the bird figure is roto-moulded plastic that will not rust. We fix the climber by grouting or as a self-standing unit. The frame is narrow, but children can fall to either side, so keep the full 18'6" x 6'6" zone free of benches, edging and plant beds.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Two ways up, one compact frame. The Net Rock Climber is an A-frame with a green rock wall on one face and a rope net on the other. Children pick the route that suits their confidence. The rock wall asks for careful foot placement on fixed holds, while the net moves under their weight and tests balance. Many children go up one side and down the other. Its footprint is only 5'3" x 4'7", with a safe play area of 10'3" x 9'7", which makes it a good fit for a society garden with limited space. The frame is finished in Lavender. Our warranty gives 3 years on galvanised pipe, composite laminates and play rope. Share your site photos and we will suggest where it goes.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.spec_paragraph: The A-frame is galvanised pipe, the climbing net is play rope and the rock face carries fixed holds. All of these sit under our 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Installation is self-standing or grouted. Check the net for wear and the holds for tightness as part of regular maintenance, and keep a soft surface on both sides of the frame.
flags: Age Group and Key User Group are NA. Capacity 15 seems high for a 5'3" x 4'7" frame. Confirm.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Shaped like a dome and strung like a spider web, the Orbit Climber gives a group of children a rope frame they can climb from any side. There is no fixed route. Children find their own path up the web, sit near the top and call to friends below, which turns climbing into a shared game. The rope gives slightly with each step, so they learn to balance as they go. The dome covers 10'4" x 10'4" and needs a square safe play area of 15'4" x 15'4". It comes in Ocean Grey, a calm colour that sits well among trees or lawns. Play rope and galvanised pipe are covered by our 3-year warranty. Ask for a layout drawing showing the dome on your site.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.spec_paragraph: The Orbit Climber combines galvanised pipe with a play rope web, both under our 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. We install it self-standing or grouted, depending on the ground. Keep the full 15'4" x 15'4" square clear on all four sides, since children climb off in every direction, and inspect the rope joints during maintenance.
flags: Age Group and Key User Group are NA. Capacity 15 not verified.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: The S Bridge Climber bends its overhead ladder into an S curve, so children must change direction halfway across. The ladder is red and sits on yellow poles, with a side ladder at each end for getting up and down. Turning mid-crossing asks children to plan each reach and shift their body weight, which is harder than a straight run of bars. It covers 13' x 7'5", with a safe play area of 18' x 12'5". This climber gives older children a fresh challenge in a school ground or park where a plain monkey bar is already in place. Colours are Play Red and Play Yellow. Galvanised pipe on this frame carries a 3-year warranty. Send us your site plan and we will mark the safe play area for you.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.spec_paragraph: The S-shaped ladder and its supporting poles are galvanised steel, which resists rust in wet weather. It can be installed self-standing or grouted. Children can drop from points across the width of the curve. Cover the full 18' x 12'5" area with an impact-absorbing surface and check the joints at each bend during maintenance.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: The Straight Net is a vertical rope net held in an upright frame, finished in New Black and Horizon Teal. Children climb the net face, swing a leg over the top and come down the other side. A rope net moves as they climb, so each step trains balance and grip together. It is a simple piece that works well for a school or society that wants to add climbing without giving up much ground. The safe play area is 10' x 5'2". Many buyers place it beside a slide or swing set to give children a short climbing station between rides. Galvanised pipe and play rope come with our 3-year warranty. Ask us how it fits alongside your existing equipment.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.spec_paragraph: The upright frame is galvanised pipe and the net is play rope, both covered for 3 years against manufacturing defects. We install it self-standing or grouted. Children can step off the top on either face, so keep an impact-absorbing surface on both sides and check the rope knots and frame clamps at every maintenance visit.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: The Tornado Climber is a long rope net course that children work through from start to finish. The net rises in waves, passes through tunnels and ends with a slide, so one run mixes climbing, crawling and sliding. It is a large piece, with a footprint of 54' x 18'10" and a safe play area of 59' x 23'10". That length suits a park edge, a resort lawn or a school ground where children can move in a line instead of crowding one spot. The frame is Horizon Teal with dark netting. Our 3-year warranty applies to the galvanised pipe frame, play rope and moulded parts. Send us your site measurements and we will show how the course runs across your ground.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.spec_paragraph: The course is built on galvanised pipe posts carrying play rope nets, with a slide at the exit. Installation is self-standing or grouted depending on the ground. With a course this long, mark the 59' x 23'10" safe play area before planning paths and benches, and inspect every net section and post fixing during routine maintenance.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Our Trampoline is a round bouncing mat set flush into the ground, with a wide dark teal surround. Because it sits at ground level there is no frame to climb onto, and children step straight on and off. Bouncing builds leg strength, rhythm and balance, and it is one of the few pieces that children of different ages enjoy together. The mat area is 5' x 5' and we recommend a safe play area of 11' x 11'. A compact trampoline like this adds variety to a society garden or school play area beside slides and climbers. It comes in the Mineral colour shade. Tell us about your ground and we will advise on placement in your layout drawing.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.spec_paragraph: The surround and mat are set into the ground, so the base work needs planning before installation. Ask us about the groundwork for your site. Keep the 11' x 11' zone clear of other equipment. Inspect the mat for wear and clear leaves and water from the edges, especially after heavy rain.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: The Wall Rock Climber is a green freestanding climbing wall dotted with multi-colour holds. At 8 ft tall and 12 ft long, it gives several children room to climb side by side, each picking a route across the coloured holds. Rock climbing asks children to plan the next move, test their footing and use their legs as much as their arms. Schools often use a wall like this for structured play during games periods, while societies place it as a standalone challenge for older children. Because it is freestanding, it can go near a boundary or in the middle of a lawn. Our 3-year warranty covers galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts and composite laminates against manufacturing defects. Ask us for a layout drawing with the wall marked on your site.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.spec_paragraph: The wall stands on its own frame and is made from weather-proof, corrosion-resistant materials. We install it self-standing or grouted. Lay an impact-absorbing surface along the full climbing face, check every hold for tightness during maintenance, and replace any hold that turns or cracks before children use the wall again.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.description: Hanging rings, a rope net and a set of spinning wheels all share one A-frame on the Wheel Thrill Climber. Children can climb the net, hang from the rings or turn the wheels, so a small group can play on it at once without waiting for a single route. The spinning wheels add a hands-on element that younger climbers enjoy, while the rings give older children a grip challenge. It takes up 11'1" x 4'7" and needs a safe play area of 16'1" x 9'7". That makes it a practical choice when a school or park wants several climbing activities on a slim footprint. Galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts and play rope are covered by our 3-year warranty. Ask us for a quote and a layout drawing.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/climber/.spec_paragraph: The A-frame is galvanised pipe and the net is play rope, both covered for 3 years. Moving parts such as bearings carry a 1-year warranty. Installation is self-standing or grouted. Check that the wheels spin freely, look over the rings and rope at each maintenance visit, and keep the 16'1" x 9'7" zone clear.
